stories.headline: TWO TANKERS HIT MINES IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ

stories.headline: UKRAINE VOWS MORE SEA STRIKES AS LIBYA MOURNS TWO DEAD
stories.sub: Libya vows retaliation after two of its naval officers are killed.

stories.headline: CHINA INVESTIGATES POLITBURO MEMBER CHEN JINING
stories.sub: Shanghai's party chief is under investigation, officials say.
